modules.name: Authentication
modules.description: Checks user credentials and manages sign-in sessions.

modules.name: Audit log
modules.description: Records security-relevant events for later review.

descriptions.text: Sign-in flow: verifies credentials against the user store and opens a session.
Checks a user's password against the stored hash and starts a session; throws if the user is unknown.
Creates a session record in the database and emits a 'session.created' event.

edges.note: recordLogin is registered as the handler for 'session.created' on this line.
